# Teamvinsible

> Teamvinsible is an AI agent coordination platform for turning one project brief into planned, reviewed, previewed, and publishable work.

## Canonical public pages

- [Home](https://teamvinsible.com/): Product overview, capabilities, workflow, and frequently asked questions.
- [Features](https://teamvinsible.com/features): Deep dive on the Nexus mediator, the specialist agent crew, and the coordination spine.
- [Agents](https://teamvinsible.com/agents): Directory of the eight specialist agents; each has its own detail page.
  - [Research Agent](https://teamvinsible.com/agents/research)
  - [Product Agent](https://teamvinsible.com/agents/product)
  - [Brand Agent](https://teamvinsible.com/agents/brand)
  - [Design Agent](https://teamvinsible.com/agents/design)
  - [Engineering Agent](https://teamvinsible.com/agents/engineering)
  - [Review Agent](https://teamvinsible.com/agents/review)
  - [Social Agent](https://teamvinsible.com/agents/social)
  - [Email Agent](https://teamvinsible.com/agents/email)
- [Teamvinsible vs AI App Builders](https://teamvinsible.com/vs/ai-app-builders): How Teamvinsible compares to one-shot AI app builders.
- [Teamvinsible vs ChatGPT Workflows](https://teamvinsible.com/vs/chatgpt-workflows): How a coordinated agent crew compares to running work through a single chat thread.
- [For Founders](https://teamvinsible.com/for/founders): How solo and early-stage founders use Teamvinsible before their first hire.
- [For Agencies](https://teamvinsible.com/for/agencies): How agencies run concurrent client briefs through a coordinated crew.
- [For Product Teams](https://teamvinsible.com/for/product-teams): How product teams parallelize execution without pulling engineers off roadmap.
- [Terms of Service](https://teamvinsible.com/terms): Terms governing use of the service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://teamvinsible.com/privacy): Data collection, processing, retention, and user rights.

## Product summary

Teamvinsible uses a Mediator to coordinate specialist Research, Product, Brand, Design, Engineering, Review, Social, and Email agents. The Coordination Spine exposes agent state, artifacts, decisions, activity, revision loops, health, previews, and publishing status.

Dashboard and authentication routes are private application surfaces and should not be indexed or cited as public product documentation.
